mentions.name: Warhammer 40k Rules Engine and Client
mentions.description: An in-browser, RTS-style rules engine and client for Warhammer 40k. It is becoming playable with a reduced rules set and is designed to be highly extensible and plug-in-able, with plans for an AI opponent or P2P networking so it can be played beyond solo testing. AI is also hoped to help generate the many thousands of simple named special rules.
mentions.problem: Currently only playable against yourself for testing; it needs an AI opponent or P2P networking to be demonstrated as the game is meant to be played.
mentions.source_excerpt: Making progress on a Warhammer 40k rules engine and client (think in-browser RTS style). It's actually getting to be playable with a reduced rules set, and designed to be highly extensible / plug-in-able.
